name: Combat repository row locking and authoritative persistence

tests.name: Rig: Create a non-FedSpace combat sector

data.sql: INSERT INTO sectors (sector_id, name) VALUES (11, 'Combat repository lock regression') ON CONFLICT (sector_id) DO NOTHING;

tests.name: Rig: Position attacker and target in sector 11

data.sql: UPDATE players SET sector_id = 11 WHERE player_id IN (@{repo_lock_attacker_player_id}, @{repo_lock_target_player_id});

tests.name: Rig: Reset both ships to known hull and shield values

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET sector_id = 11, shields = 0, hull = 100 WHERE ship_id IN (SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE player_id IN (@{repo_lock_attacker_player_id}, @{repo_lock_target_player_id}));

tests.name: Read target ship id and authoritative pre-combat hull

data.sql: SELECT s.ship_id, s.hull FROM ships s JOIN players p ON p.ship_id = s.ship_id WHERE p.player_id = @{repo_lock_target_player_id};

tests.name: Attack target through locked combat repository query
Verify target damage was persisted despite success response

data.sql: SELECT hull FROM ships WHERE ship_id = @{repo_lock_target_ship_id};
